Secondary treated wastewater is chlorinated and dechlorinated and is either diverted to tertiary treatment or is metered prior to discharge.
Waste activated sludge is thickened by dissolved air floatation and blended with primary solids before anaerobic digestion.
Digested sludge is dewatered by belt filter press and hauled offsite for disposal at the Monterey Regional Waste Management District Landfill.

Treated secondary effluent is filtered using a submerged microfiltration system which produces filtrate under vacuum conditions by a filtration pump.
The microfiltration system serves as a pretreatment to reverse osmosis; a portion of the microfiltration flow is not treated by reverse osmosis but instead blended with reverse osmosis permeate.
The Tertiary Facilities include a flow equalization basin, four chlorine contact basins, a Lamella Thickener, and a reclamation wet well and conveyance pumps.
